page_title: Caricature Maker: Turn Your Photo into a Caricature Online with AI

sources.entry: Caricature Maker - photo to caricature using AI.

summary.name: Caricature Maker
summary.one_liner: An online AI tool that turns an uploaded photo into a funny, exaggerated caricature that still resembles the person.
use_cases: Making a profile picture or avatar
Creating a funny birthday or anniversary gift
Making a caricature of a team for an About page
Turning a group or couple photo into one caricature
summary.what_it_does: Users upload a photo (JPG, PNG or WEBP up to 25MB, per the FAQ) and the AI generates a caricature that exaggerates distinctive facial features while keeping the likeness. The page says results arrive in a few seconds and can be downloaded in high resolution. Group, couple, landscape, portrait and square photos are supported, and the output keeps the shape of the input photo. The page says uploaded photos are deleted after generation and states the output may be used personally or commercially once downloaded.
notable: Group, couple and wide or tall photos are kept in the same shape as the original
Credit-based pricing with no subscription: Pro pack $10 for 20, Ultimate pack $30 for 70
Page states photos are deleted after generation and not used for advertising
caveats: Requires purchasing credits (1 credit per caricature); the page says there is no subscription
Page advises a clear, front-facing, well-lit photo; sunglasses, masks or heavy filters may hurt results
Some FAQ text says sign-in is required before upload
